linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Italian pass identified eight remaining trigonometry formula and worked-example terminology defects; all eight were corrected.

findings.summary: The Italian right-triangle formulas retained English side labels.
evidence: The formulas used opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse instead of opposto, adiacente, and ipotenusa.
findings.resolution: Localized all three side labels in the formulas.

findings.summary: The inverse-trigonometry formulas retained English side labels.
evidence: The previous expressions contained opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse.
findings.resolution: Localized the side labels while preserving inverse-function notation.

findings.summary: The worked trigonometry example retained English side labels.
evidence: The example formulas began with opposite and adjacent despite localized Italian prose.
findings.resolution: Changed the labels to opposto and adiacente.

findings.summary: The right-triangle formula terminology was inconsistent with the localized explanation.
evidence: The surrounding paragraph used Italian side terminology while the displayed formulas used English.
findings.resolution: Aligned formula labels with the established Italian prose.

findings.summary: The inverse formulas were inconsistent with the localized right-triangle terminology.
evidence: The inverse expressions did not reuse opposto, adiacente, and ipotenusa.
findings.resolution: Made the inverse formulas consistent with the Italian section.

findings.summary: The example formulas were inconsistent with the localized inverse formulas.
evidence: The worked example retained English labels after the explanatory text had been translated.
findings.resolution: Applied the same Italian side terminology to the example.

findings.summary: The right-triangle section mixed Italian prose with English formula labels.
evidence: A reader saw Italian explanations paired with English side names in all three formulas.
findings.resolution: Normalized the complete formula set to Italian terminology.

findings.summary: The side labels were inconsistent across the Italian angle-finding section.
evidence: Inverse formulas and worked examples used English labels in an otherwise Italian section.
findings.resolution: Used one consistent Italian terminology set throughout the angle-finding section.
